capabilities: convert the current note's Markdown to WhatsApp formatting
map Markdown elements like bold, italics, blockquotes, and headings to WhatsApp equivalents
remove unsupported elements such as images, horizontal lines, and links
convert highlights and headings to bold and equations to code
disambiguation: Not a WhatsApp integration; it only converts the note's Markdown so it can be pasted into WhatsApp.
extras: README notes that Obsidian links are not supported and must be removed manually; also available in Brazilian Portuguese.
problem: WhatsApp does not understand Markdown, so pasting an Obsidian note there loses bold, italics, and other formatting.
summary: Markdown-to-WhatsApp converter that transforms the current note into WhatsApp-supported formatting for sharing.
